title: Prime-Gap Ruptures: Reproducibility Package
description: Code, exact datasets, automated tests and figures accompanying Riccardo Panza's observational paper on record prime-gap transitions that skip intermediate half-gap levels and the later recovery of those levels. Original code is MIT-licensed; the paper, original figures and original derived research content are CC BY 4.0. OEIS extracts retain CC BY-SA 4.0. Other third-party numerical source material is excluded from these grants; see LICENSE.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for scope and limitations.
